serverInfo.description: The largest free reference of ServiceNow system properties (sys_properties) for AI assistants. Look up any glide.* or com.* property by name or search 7,300+ properties by topic (SSO, email, security, performance, UI, integrations, upgrades) and get plain English explanations of what each property does, its type, default value, affected area and when to review it, with a link to the full property page on sysproperties.do. Free, public, no API key or login required.
